step1_analysis.description: A fragment of a dead-zone amplifier containing a series NMOS stack (XM2, XM3) that defines the dead-zone threshold, a diode-connected bias transistor (XM1), and a standalone NMOS (XM4). The series stack creates a specific turn-on threshold (dead-zone) controlled by the input gate voltage.

paper_reference.title: A New TX Leakage-Suppression Technique for an RFID Receiver Using a Dead-Zone Amplifier

Voltage_Gain.description: AC voltage gain of the NMOS stack (XM2, XM3) when loaded with a resistor.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rload. For W/L=5/0.5 at ~100uA, gm is approx 1mS. With a 10k load, gain = 10 V/V = 20 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The sub-circuit only provides a single stage of amplification, so the gain will be much lower than the full receiver's 89dB.

Dead_Zone_Voltage.description: The input voltage at N0 required to overcome the threshold of the series NMOS stack and begin conducting current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vth of two series NMOS transistors. Base Vth is ~0.42V, plus body effect on the top transistor.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The series connection increases the effective threshold voltage slightly due to the source of XM3 being elevated above ground.

DC_Power.description: Total DC power consumption of the sub-circuit under typical bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total * VDD. With a 10k load and 1.8V supply, max branch current is 180uA. Plus bias current.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the applied bias at N0 and N4. Assumed typical analog biasing for SKY130 at 1.8V.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the DC power, AC voltage gain, and the dead-zone threshold voltage of the NMOS stack.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Dead-Zone Amplifier Sub-circuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N0 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VDD N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Power and Bias Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN2 N2 0 0
Ibias VDD N3 10u
VN4 N4 0 0.4

* Input signal at N0 (Gate of the stack)
VIN N0 0 dc 0.6 ac 1 sin(0.6 0.1 1Meg)

* Load resistor for the stack output
RL N1 VDD 10k

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let total_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print total_power

  * 2. AC Analysis for Voltage Gain
  ac dec 10 1k 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(N1)
  meas ac gain_at_1k find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac gain_at_100M find gain_db at=100Meg

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 10n 5u
  meas tran vout_pp pp v(N1)

  * 4. DC Sweep for Dead-Zone Threshold
  * Sweep input from 0 to 1.8V. 
  * When V(N1) drops by 10mV (to 1.79V), current is 1uA, marking the threshold.
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc dead_zone_vth when v(N1)=1.79 fall=1

  quit
.endc
